review:
Candy Corner is a 7x7 cluster slot where six or more matching fruits form a win. Purple wilds appear on all reels, and the four corners of the grid hold special spots for modifiers.

Chocolate modifiers award instant cash from 2x to 50x, and green candies bring a random multiplier for all wins; cannons and rockets add other effects. Pragmatic Play advertises up to 10,000x. The RTP is 96.5%. The corner modifiers give each spin a little extra suspense.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
